cross_package_notes.file: frontend/src/utils/security.ts, frontend/src/utils/protectedFile.ts, frontend/src/utils/htmlToMarkdown.ts (owned by Slice 1 w6-fe-core-utils)
cross_package_notes.note: Verified read-only sanitizer and protected-image hydration contracts consumed by doc-content.vue, document-preview.vue, SkillFilesPanel.vue, UserMenu.vue, ChatCitationFloat.vue, ChatReferencesDrawer.vue, and stableHtml.ts. All component props/emits and composable return types were preserved unchanged.

Verified caller usage of IMChannelPanel.vue: WeChat QR rendering was migrated from external api.qrserver.com to local <t-qrcode>, WeChat long-polling teardown was hardened across drawer close and unmount, and redacted channel credential edits preserve stored backend secrets without changing IMChannelPanel props or emits.
Verified caller compatibility for useCitationPopover, useEmbedChatSession, useEmbedBridge, useResourcePins, useSandboxDesktop, useSandboxTerminal, useVoiceInput, and useConfigSkillInstallProgress.

invariants_checked: Zero external CDN @import or url(...) references across base.css, main.css, and theme/tokens.less; all styles are 100% offline/air-gapped safe.
Zero legacy brand identifiers, class prefixes, or host paths across all 4 stylesheet and style-guard files.
Design-token and styling ratchet invariants in frontend/src/assets/theme/styleGuard.test.mjs pass 10/10 baseline checks after all Wave 6 component edits.

All 189 original component files plus 2 new regression test suites audited line-by-line for DOM XSS across every v-html, v-stable-html, innerHTML, outerHTML, <iframe src/srcdoc>, DOCX/XLSX/PDF/Markdown/Mermaid/SVG previewer, citation popover, and reference drawer.
Every external anchor (<a :href>, target="_blank") and window.open call validates http:/https: URL schemes and enforces rel="noopener noreferrer" / 'noopener,noreferrer'.

Offline/air-gapped safety and GENYEE brand hygiene verified across all components: zero third-party QR or favicon requests (migrated IMChannelPanel WeChat QR to local <t-qrcode> and removed Google s2/favicons leak in ChatReferencesDrawer), local bundled pdfjs worker only, and zero legacy brand residues.

Secret-preservation and async lifecycle hygiene verified across editors, drawers, selectors, uploaders, and guides: redacted credentials are never overwritten with empty maps or '***' placeholders, ObjectURLs/timers/window listeners/long-polls are cleaned up on close and unmount, and stale async responses are fenced by sequence/generation guards.

findings.summary: IMChannelPanel exfiltrated live WeChat login QR tokens to external api.qrserver.com (breaking air-gapped deployments and leaking login URLs), wiped stored channel secrets or blocked WeChat/Yunzhijia edits when saving existing channels whose credentials are redacted on GET (credentials_configured: true), and leaked WeChat QR long-polling when the drawer closed via overlay/ESC.
findings.regression_test: IMChannelPanel renders WeChat QR locally without api.qrserver.com and preserves stored credentials on edit

findings.summary: ChatCitationFloat and ChatReferencesDrawer bound unvalidated web citation/reference URLs directly to <a :href>, enabling javascript:/data: URI XSS on click, and ChatReferencesDrawer leaked cited domains to external www.google.com/s2/favicons (failing offline and leaking query context).
findings.regression_test: ChatCitationFloat blocks javascript: and data: hrefs while rendering https: links safely; ChatReferencesDrawer blocks unsafe web item hrefs and never loads external Google favicons

findings.summary: doc-content interpolated unescaped code in Mermaid/code fallback HTML, lacked rel="noopener noreferrer" and http(s): validation on URL source links, and leaked stale audio preview blobs across rapid switches; document-preview inserted unsanitized docx-preview DOM output and unescaped Excel sheet names; SkillFilesPanel rendered unsanitized image/svg+xml data URLs and lacked selectFile/loadFiles race guards; UserMenu opened external docs/GitHub without noopener,noreferrer or scheme checks and leaked tenantSubmenuHideTimer on unmount.
findings.regression_test: doc-content escapes HTML in Mermaid/code blocks, adds noopener on source link, and guards audio blob races; document-preview sanitizes rendered DOCX DOM nodes and escapes Excel sheet names; SkillFilesPanel sanitizes SVG data URLs, rejects non-image media_type, and ignores stale file responses; UserMenu enforces noopener,noreferrer and safe URL schemes on openDocs/openGithub and clears submenu timer

findings.summary: CredentialResource wiped configured state when parent updated api and meta in the same reactive flush; TenantSelector dropped clearSearch/search updates while loading and polluted setAllTenants with filtered search results; SandboxConfigEditorDrawer allowed renaming masked env keys to submit literal '***' placeholders and lacked drawer-session async guards; SandboxSkillsPanel lacked record-switch guards across async mutations; ModelEditorDialog leaked its 1s Ollama download polling interval across dialog close/unmount and could overwrite modelName across model switches.
findings.regression_test: CredentialResource preserves configured state when parent switches api and meta in the same flush; TenantSelector does not drop clearSearch while searchTenants is in flight or overwrite setAllTenants with filtered results; SandboxConfigEditorDrawer, SandboxSkillsPanel, and ModelEditorDialog enforce secret identity and generation guards

findings.summary: Lifecycle cleanup and rapid-switch race hardening across 15 components: PdfSourceViewer reactive props.data reload + loadGeneration cancel, manual-knowledge-editor initGeneration guard, AttachmentUpload session/unmount guard on upload completion, Input-field image ObjectURL revoke on unmount + sharedAgentKbReqSeq, ChatHeader editingSessionId capture + grantsLoadSeq, and timer/listener/request sequence cleanup across guides, selectors, and drawers.
findings.regression_test: PdfSourceViewer, AttachmentUpload, Input-field, ChatHeader, guides, and selectors clean up timers, blobs, and stale loads

verification_commands: (cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test src/assets/theme/styleGuard.test.mjs src/directives/*.test.* src/hooks/*.test.* src/components/*.test.* src/components/*/*.test.*) (exit 0)

invariants_checked: All 76 original composable files plus 3 new regression test suites audited line-by-line for SSE streaming, chat session switching, WebSocket/noVNC/xterm sandbox lifecycles, voice input recording/transcription, embed postMessage origin isolation, and singleton pin/favorite caching.
AbortController cancellation, timer clearing, EventListener removal, and ObjectURL revocation verified on both component unmount/effectScope disposal and rapid session/tenant/user switches.
Citation popover URL handling enforces strict http:/https: scheme validation before exposing external links to floating citation cards.
Zero external CDN/API dependencies and zero legacy brand residues across all composables.

findings.summary: useCitationPopover.openWeb copied raw data-url attributes into float.value.url without URL scheme validation, propagating javascript:/data: payloads into ChatCitationFloat.
findings.regression_test: useCitationPopover blocks javascript: and data: URLs in openWeb while keeping https:

findings.summary: Singleton useResourcePins registered its tenant watcher inside the first caller component's effectScope (dying permanently once that component unmounted), ignored authStore.user?.id switches on shared home workspaces, and reused/applied stale in-flight listFavorites responses across tenant switches.
findings.regression_test: useResourcePins keeps watching tenant and user switches after the first caller scope disposes; useResourcePins discards stale in-flight listFavorites responses from an earlier tenant

findings.summary: useEmbedChatSession failed to cancel its 500ms debouncedScrollTop timer on session switch or unmount, cleared historyLoading/historyLoadingMore for a newly selected session when an older session's getmsgList settled, and lacked session-switch/unmount guards across await fileToDataURI in sendMsg.
findings.regression_test: stale getmsgList settlement from session-a does not clear session-b historyLoading or cancel debounced scroll missing; sendMsg aborts before pushing message or starting stream when session switches during fileToDataURI

findings.summary: useSandboxDesktop allowed async disconnect events from a retired noVNC RFB client to clobber active connection status and schedule duplicate reconnects and lacked connectEpoch/sessionId guards across async ticket minting; useSandboxTerminal lacked connectEpoch/sessionId guards across ticket minting and wrote stored PTY IDs to reactive sessionId.value instead of the socket's captured sid.
findings.regression_test: useSandboxDesktop ignores async disconnect from retired RFB client and aborts stale sessionId ticket; useSandboxTerminal aborts stale ticket on session switch and scopes stored PTY id to socket sid

findings.summary: useEmbedBridge re-populated setEmbedAllowedOrigins and called postEmbedReady if bootstrap() resolved after unmount; useVoiceInput invoked onText/onError callbacks if transcribeAudio resolved/rejected after unmount; useConfigSkillInstallProgress lacked onScopeDispose(stopAll) cleanup for openWhenHidden SSE controllers.
findings.regression_test: useEmbedBridge does not set allowed origins or post ready if unmounted during bootstrap; useVoiceInput suppresses onText and onError when component unmounts during transcription; useConfigSkillInstallProgress aborts active SSE controllers on effectScope disposal

invariants_checked: DOM morphing directive v-stable-html (stableHtml.ts) preserves decoded protected blob images and rendered Mermaid SVGs during streaming tokens while invalidating stale media/diagrams whenever underlying data-protected-src or Mermaid source text changes.
Defense-in-depth HTML scrubbing in parseIncoming strips <script>, <iframe>, <object>, <embed>, inline on* event handlers, and javascript:/vbscript:/unsafe data: URIs before DOM insertion or morphing.
Zero legacy brand residues or external network calls in directives.

findings.summary: morphImage preserved stale blob src and data-protected-src attributes whenever two protected images shared identical alt text (e.g. default 'image' alt across message switches); morphMermaidCanvas preserved stale rendered SVGs even when the Mermaid diagram source changed; parseIncoming lacked defense-in-depth scrubbing against <script>/<iframe>/<object>/<embed>, inline on* attributes, and javascript:/data: URIs.
findings.regression_test: decoded protected image with identical alt updates when data-protected-src changes; mermaid canvas keeps painted svg during streaming ticks but invalidates when source changes; vStableHtml strips dangerous elements, event handlers, and javascript URIs

invariants_checked: useKnowledgeBase.ts revokes blob ObjectURLs immediately after triggering file downloads, validates file upload extensions, and contains zero legacy brand residues.
useMarqueeSelect.ts removes window pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel listeners both on drag completion (stop) and in onBeforeUnmount, verified by useMarqueeSelect.test.ts (5/5 passing).
